turns.doctor_question: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response:
Nice to meet you too. Well, I'm here because I'm having a major issue at work lately. I manage construction sites, and... every time I have to get near a scaffold, or a roof edge, or an upper platform now, my head just tells me I'm about to go right over the edge. 

It doesn't even make sense to me, because I can look right at it and see the rails are in place. I know the setup is supposed to be safe, but I just can't shake that feeling. It's getting really hard to do my job.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient reports marked fear and intrusive apprehension about falling when near heights (scaffolds, roof edges, upper platforms), recognizing that the fear is out of proportion to the actual safety measures in place.

turns.doctor_question: Does this fear happen only when you’re up high or near an edge?
turns.patient_response: Yeah, pretty much. It's... well, the second I step onto any temporary stairs, or even just walk toward an open upper floor, it hits me immediately. My chest tightens right up, my hands get all wet and sweaty, and... I just feel like my legs might lock up on me before I can even make myself take another step.

symptom_reasoning.S063: The patient describes an immediate panic and physiological fear response, including chest tightness, sweating hands, and feeling frozen ('legs might lock up'), the instant they encounter heights or temporary stairs.

turns.doctor_question: Have you ever had one of these sudden panic episodes when you were not near a height or an edge?
turns.patient_response: No, not at all. It's really just the heights. If I'm down on the ground level, or working in the site trailer, I'm completely fine. It's only when I have to go up. I don't get that feeling anywhere else.

symptom_reasoning.S062: The patient confirms that their panic episodes are restricted specifically to heights ('It's really just the heights... It's only when I have to go up. I don't get that feeling anywhere else.').
